translations.web: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
translations.bsb: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
translations.kjv: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
translations.asv: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.
